title: Asks you to install an app from a message
why: Apps sent in messages can read your SMS, including OTPs, and take over your banking apps. The Play Store is the only safe place to install from.
examples: Your account is blocked. Install SBI_KYC_Update.apk to continue.
Download the new app to verify your electricity bill and avoid disconnection.
safe: Download the official HDFC app from the Play Store for easy banking.
Your app update is ready in the Play Store.
